items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When he broke the band up, the big band, he formed a sextet, and I was the tenor player

ctx.x: You got to play with one of your heroes. What you used to – you said earlier that you and Trane would sit around and say, do you think we’ll ever play with Dizzy?

Yeah, be good enough to play. When he broke the band up, the big band, he formed a sextet, and I was the tenor player, and a trombone player out of Atlanta, Silly Willy. He only had one lung. Could play his brains out. He died, much too soon. That was his sextet.
